title: Atomic response products and cognitive actions contradict the exact response demand

evidence.source_boundary: Each prompt explicitly requires writing or completing SQL; taxonomy requires CODE/CONSTRUCT.
The prompts require a tuple definition/example, completion of three database-identification rows, or identification of a DBMS feature; no code is produced.
Both prompts require drawing a logic circuit; taxonomy requires DIAGRAM/CONSTRUCT.
Each prompt requires executing a bit-manipulation instruction and deriving the resulting register value; equivalent B22 tasks use CALCULATION/APPLY.
The prompt asks for two prose explanations on labelled answer lines; taxonomy places explanation in EXTENDED_TEXT/EXPLAIN.
The prompt asks for a formal logic expression from a circuit; taxonomy requires SYMBOLIC_NOTATION/TRANSLATE_REPRESENTATION.
The prompt asks the candidate to populate three answer rows from a supplied network diagram; no elements are connected or matched by lines.
The scored response also requires description, justification, impact, explanation or mapped prevention/reason evidence; the cognitive action and response product must preserve that scored demand.

evidence.problem: A tuple definition/example and a three-row primary-key/candidate-key/relationship table are paired only because both were incorrectly labelled CODE/CONSTRUCT under PC-B22-V2-080.

required_action: Reclassify every affected row from the complete target prompt, context and official marking behaviour using the accepted taxonomy; rebuild affected patterns and variant suggestions. Remove or regenerate VC-B22-V2-0048; regenerate VC-B22-V2-0047 under the corrected circuit-drawing tuple.
